wrapper_policy.normalize: TriggerCondition::event recursively unwraps InZone, Granted, OncePerTurn, DuringOpponentsTurn, CastFromHand, CastFromExile, When, InterveningIf, TreasureManaSpent, ManaSpent (cards.rs4783-4802). Preserve underlying event semantics.
wrapper_policy.wrappers: Origin/timing/player/payment/count/threshold qualifiers add no arbitrary physical objects. A separately explicit subject such as targeted creature or ability-of-creature is captured by its producer.
wrapper_policy.clones: Extra trigger instances and copies must clone retained exact semantic identities; a freshly registered delayed callback must not inherit unrelated initiating-event identities. Delayed family is s-z owner inventory.
wrapper_policy.cold_payload: Use additive cold semantic object set, preserving existing DamageActor/Controller/Copiable/CreatureComparison and typed scalar event payloads. Identity-only references need no LKI characteristic refresh. Deduplicate exact identity, never replace by current card incarnation.
wrapper_policy.hidden_information: All refs above originate public spell/ability/permanent events. No scan of hidden hands/libraries or candidate physical cards. Players/counters/scalars are not objects. Mana abilities are not StackObjects. Physical spell and ability-stack forms should not yield duplicate representations of one source.

rules.CR609.7a: All semantically referred objects, not only damage-capable sources; exact incarnation retained after departure.

common_constraints: Effect-independent retention at actual matching dispatcher, before cloned multiplicity expansion.
Retain existing typed event facts; merge semantic identities instead of replacing connive/comparison/copy/damage payloads.
Before/after identities are distinct; never rebind old reference to latest generation.
One-or-more batches retain exactly all qualifying event objects, not the first match or unrelated whole event.
Do not scan hidden zones or English at runtime; internal identity retention must not expose hidden card characteristics. Public-after links only where rules authorize.
Attachments, grantors, original targets, paid cards and initiating packets contain incidental metadata; include only when printed condition/effect actually refers to that object.
Generic dynamically sampled sets and guard witnesses are not fixed object rosters until their relevant event/effect determines them.
Typed wrappers InZone/Granted/OncePerTurn/When/InterveningIf and cast-origin/mana qualifiers retain the underlying event identity rules; wrappers do not introduce unrelated witness objects.
